abstract: Brain health depends on the blood-brain barrier blocking neurotoxins while allowing essential proteins to pass, but which proteins cross this barrier remains poorly understood. In this issue of Cell, Zhou and colleagues define the brain plasma proteome and show that protein transport selectively changes in neurodegeneration.
